Champion innovation by driving adoption of emerging technologies, modern tools, and improved ways of working while ensuring delivery accountability.
Provide executive leadership oversight across engineering activities spanning four business units.
Ensure delivery excellence across cost, schedule, quality, regulatory, and customer requirements.
Establish governance models, metrics, and operating rhythms to ensure consistent execution and accountability across teams.
Own resource planning, prioritization, and allocation to optimize delivery against business and program commitments.
Standardize engineering processes, tools, and best practices to improve efficiency and scalability across the Sector.
Build and develop a strong leadership pipeline and high-performing engineering organization.

Advanced Degree in Engineering or related technical discipline with a minimum of 15 years of prior related leadership experience.

Ability and willingness to travel up to 50% of the time, including international travel, as required.

Demonstrated experience leading large-scale, multi-disciplinary engineering organizations across multiple business units or sites.

Strong project management skills with the ability to plan, execute, and deliver complex initiatives on time and within budget.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Altana is the network for trusted trade. Our AI-powered product network empowers governments and businesses to build a more resilient and secure global economy while keeping trade flowing.

The Opportunity at Altana

As the Senior Director of Platform Engineering, you will own the foundation that the entire Altana engineering organization builds on: the cloud infrastructure that runs our products and the developer experience that determines how fast and how safely we ship. You will lead a multidisciplinary organization spanning Cloud Engineering, Developer Experience, Site Reliability, and DevSecOps / Release Engineering — with end-to-end ownership of our build, test, and release pipelines.

This is a moment of real transformation in how software is built. We are reorganizing our engineering practice around an AI-first, agent-first model, where AI coding harnesses and autonomous agents are first-class participants in the software development lifecycle. We are looking for a leader who has done this work before — someone who has built and scaled developer experience and platform organizations, and who has direct, hands-on experience and strong, well-formed opinions about agentic coding, AI-assisted development, and what it takes to make an engineering org dramatically more productive.

You will set the technical strategy, build and develop the team, and personally raise the bar on engineering excellence. You will be measured by the reliability and cost-efficiency of our platforms, the velocity and happiness of every engineer who depends on them, and how effectively Altana adopts AI across the development lifecycle.

Key areas under your stewardship

Cloud Engineering:
You will design, manage, and secure the multi-cloud infrastructure that powers our products — architectures that are scalable, flexible, resilient, and cost-performant across both commercial and government-compliant deployments. This includes the data platforms that support large-scale data processing, analytics, and machine learning, enabling our teams to work with world-scale datasets and build data-driven solutions.

Developer Experience:
You will own the infrastructure and tooling the engineering organization relies on every day — our monorepo, CI/CD platform, build systems, local development environments, and internal tooling — and the end-to-end experience of working in our codebase from clone to production. This is the center of gravity for the role: driving Developer Acceleration across the board and making AI-first, agent-first development the default way Altana engineers work.

Site Reliability:
You will ensure our systems are reliable, available, performant, and efficient. The SRE function establishes and monitors SLOs and error budgets, owns observability, drives toil reduction, and leads incident management so our services run smoothly and recover quickly from disruption.

DevOps / Release Engineering:
You will bridge development and operations, automating and optimizing the software delivery lifecycle from commit to deploy. Through robust CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code, your team ensures new features and updates ship rapidly, safely, and consistently.

Your Responsibilities

Technical Strategy & Execution

Define and own a clear, multi-year technical strategy for Platform Engineering, ensuring the team stays focused on the highest-leverage work while advancing long-term architectural goals.
Set the reference architecture and standards for cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and developer tooling, balancing immediate operational needs against strategic investment.
Make and guide key decisions on scalability, performance, security, and cost, working closely with engineers on the hardest problems rather than from a distance.
Lead build-vs-buy and platform investment decisions, including which tools, vendors, and open-source technologies to adopt across the SDLC.

Developer Experience & Acceleration

Own the Developer Acceleration program: instrument and continuously improve developer workflows, driving measurable gains in build times, PR cycle time, flaky-test rate, and deployment frequency (DORA / SPACE).
Drive an AI-first, agent-first transformation of the software development lifecycle — making AI coding harnesses and agents reliable, governed, first-class participants in how Altana writes, reviews, tests, and ships code.
Set strategy for integrating AI-assisted development tools and agentic coding harnesses (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and agent frameworks) into CI/CD, code review, local development, and release pipelines at scale.
Establish how AI-assisted and agent-generated code is reviewed, tested, secured, and governed — including LLM-aware testing strategies, evaluation and guardrails, and the supporting context engineering and tooling that make agents effective in a large monorepo.
Treat the engineering organization as your customer: gather requirements from application teams, translate vague friction into well-scoped platform work, and prove impact through before/after measurement.
Evolve our monorepo strategy — code organization, dependency management, build caching, and testing patterns — so it works consistently across our multi-cloud and compliance-constrained environments.

Operational Excellence

Establish and continuously improve best practices for monitoring, incident response, automation, and performance optimization across production and the delivery pipeline.
Drive a culture of ownership, resilience, and accountability to ensure high availability, performance, and security in our production environments.
Own reliability and cost across cloud infrastructure; conduct regular post-incident reviews and capacity planning to anticipate and mitigate risk before it reaches customers.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

Partner across product, engineering, security, data science, and commercial teams to align platform investment with business objectives.
Communicate trade-offs, constraints, and roadmap clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and represent Platform Engineering to senior leadership.
Manage relationships with external vendors and partners, including cloud providers and tooling vendors.

Team Leadership & Development

Lead, coach, and inspire a multidisciplinary organization of engineers and managers across software, infrastructure, reliability, and developer tooling.
Manage distributed teams across multiple time zones, maintaining alignment and a cohesive culture in a remote-friendly environment.
Recruit top-tier talent and act as a top-notch recruiter yourself; foster professional development, recognize outstanding performance, and address underperformance constructively and in a timely way.

About You

Experience building, leading, and scaling best-in-class platform and/or developer experience organizations, ideally in a rapidly scaling environment, including leading managers and senior engineers.
10+ years of real-world experience developing or managing complex engineering systems, with significant time spent owning developer experience, platform engineering, or the build/test/release pipeline end to end.
A proven track record of driving developer experience and developer productivity across an organization — you can point to concrete before/after outcomes (build times, PR cycle time, deployment frequency, reliability) from initiatives you led.
Direct, hands-on experience with AI-assisted and agentic development — AI coding harnesses, agent-first / AI-first workflows, and coding agents — and clear, well-formed opinions about how they change code review, testing, pipeline design, and engineering org structure.
Deep expertise with CI/CD systems (Buildkite, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar) and a demonstrated ability to scale them, ideally in a monorepo at scale.
Strong software engineering fundamentals — you design well-architected systems and lead from the front, not just from the org chart.
Production experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), and infrastructure as code (Terraform / OpenTofu).
A track record tackling large-scale infrastructure in support of fast-paced ML/AI-enabled products and services.
Experience designing tooling and patterns that work across multiple clouds or isolated / air-gapped and compliance-constrained environments (FedRAMP, SOC 2, or similar) is a strong plus.
Strong sense of shared ownership, a collaborative disposition, and excellent written and verbal communication skills.

The Senior Manager, Infrastructure Security, is responsible for defining, maturing, and advancing the Firm's infrastructure security strategy across servers, operating systems, cloud platforms, data protection technologies, core infrastructure networks, and foundational technology services. The successful candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong leadership skills and is equally comfortable developing long-term security roadmaps and rolling up their sleeves to solve technical challenges. This individual must be highly analytical, detail-oriented, adaptable, and capable of navigating ambiguity while driving measurable security outcomes in a fast-paced enterprise environment.

Define and execute the Firm's infrastructure security strategy, roadmap, and operating model.
Develop and maintain plans to mature infrastructure security capabilities aligned with business objectives and enterprise risk priorities.
Establish security standards, architectural patterns, engineering principles, and technical guardrails across infrastructure platforms.
Lead the design, implementation, and management of security controls across: Windows and Linux server environments, Endpoint platforms (Windows, macOS, mobile), Cloud environments (Azure, SaaS/PaaS etc.), Storage and data protection platforms, Network security technologies (Firewalls, IDS/IPS etc.), Virtualization and container platforms, Remote access technologies

Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and cross-functional stakeholders.
Exceptional organizational, planning, and program management skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, make sound decisions under pressure, balance strategic planning with hands-on technical engagement, and communicate effectively with both technical and business audiences.
Highly analytical with exceptional problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.

Your opportunity

At Schwab, you’re empowered to make an impact on your career. Here, innovative thought meets creative problem solving, helping us “challenge the status quo” and transform the finance industry together.

We believe in the importance of in-office collaboration and fully intend for the selected candidate for this role to work on site in the specified location(s).

Schwab Technology Services enables the future of how clients manage their money by providing innovative and reliable technology products and services as a part of our ongoing commitment to democratize access to investing and financial planning.

Wealth and Advice Solutions Technology (WAS Tech) is an organization within Schwab Technology Services dedicated to supporting the technology needs of the Wealth and Advice Solutions (WAS) business. Our mission is to empower high-net-worth (HNW) and ultra-high-net-worth (UHNW) clients by delivering differentiated offerings and tailored financial advice that meet their unique needs.

This role is part of a highly talented and experienced architecture team responsible for setting the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Schwab Wealth and Advice Solutions platform. The team works in close partnership with Enterprise Architecture, ensuring architectural decisions support long-term business goals, future scalability and high resiliency. The team’s collaborative approach with product leaders fosters an environment where cutting-edge technology solutions are appreciated as a critical component of achieving business objectives which drive ongoing market leadership.

In this position, you will collaborate closely with a talented, motivated team of technologists who are passionate about making technology a strategic differentiator for Schwab’s WAS business and its clients. Your leadership and technical acumen will be essential in shaping a cohesive architecture strategy that aligns with business objectives and industry best practices.

This role requires a strong background in leading architecture strategy as well as hands-on experience throughout the implementation lifecycle. You should be comfortable influencing technology direction, providing expert guidance, and ensuring the successful delivery of complex, integrated solutions in a fast-paced, agile environment.

Key Responsibilities

Define and evolve the target architecture for wealth management platforms, including Schwab Wealth advisory systems, portfolio management, CRM integrations, client portals, digital advice, Wealth vendor integration.
Lead architecture strategy, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps that improve scalability, security, availability, and advisor and client experiences.
Design secure, scalable integration patterns across core wealth applications, custodians, market data providers, enterprise services, third-party fintech platforms, and AI-enabled capabilities.

Stay current on industry trends in wealth management technology, generative AI, analytics, and digital advisory platforms, and apply that insight to drive innovation.

What you have

Extensive experience serving as a Technical Architect for large-scale, enterprise-wide wealth management platforms, with deep expertise across portfolio management, trading and rebalancing, risk, reporting, financial planning, CRM, client engagement, and wealth management operations.
10+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, preferably in Java, with at least 5+ years designing, developing, and integrating solutions in the investment services or wealth management industry.
Strong technical depth in enterprise application architecture across distributed systems, APIs, middleware, microservices, event-driven systems, and hybrid cloud environments.

Solid understanding of the wealth management technology ecosystem, including custodians, portfolio management platforms, CRM solutions, reporting tools, financial planning systems, and advisor workstation technologies.
Experience leading cloud transformation and digital modernization initiatives in financial services.

Experience supporting production operations and applying Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles to improve system reliability, observability, performance, and operational excellence.

Excellent communication, documentation, stakeholder management, and leadership skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders, build alignment, and drive decisions across diverse teams.

Promotes creativity, experimentation, and strategic thinking to differentiate Schwab from its competitors.
Experience with Enterprise Architecture practices and standards.

Experience with CI/CD pipelines, with GitHub suite preferred.

Location:

About the Role

We're seeking a Director of Engineering to lead a small, established engineering team through its next stage of growth. Recently acquired by Metro Global, the company has the stability and backing of institutional ownership and is at an inflection point: ready to modernize its development practices, sharpen execution, and accelerate delivery.

This is a hands-on, player-coach role, combining small-company freedom, influence, and growth with stable backing and resources. You'll lead a team of ~twenty engineers across backend, frontend, and QA while staying close enough to the code and architecture to make technical decisions. You'll partner closely with existing technical leadership to set direction and own the day-to-day execution that turns vision into shipped product.

You should be passionate about designing and iterating on development processes, leveraging AI tools, helping the team perform at their best, and solving varied problems as the company grows. No specific prior title is required, as long as you have experience working with a team to improve processes and output.

Responsibilities

Engineering Leadership & Execution:
Lead and mentor the engineering team across backend, frontend, and QA
Own the overall technical architecture and make key decisions on system design and technology choices
Diagnose and eliminate the bottlenecks slowing delivery, implementing improvements quickly
Establish clear delivery metrics, sprint cadences, and accountability frameworks to accelerate feature delivery
Build and scale the processes, tools, and practices that enable faster, more reliable releases

Product & Roadmap Management:
Partner with leadership to define product vision and translate business objectives into technical roadmaps
Own and prioritize the engineering roadmap, balancing new features, technical debt, and infrastructure
Coordinate across backend, frontend, and QA to ensure alignment and efficient delivery
Drive sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives to maintain development momentum

AI Execution:
Define and maintain a playbook of AI-driven development best practices, evolving it as tools and techniques mature
Evaluate, pilot, and deploy AI tooling that brings AI capabilities into production environments
Identify high-value points across the product to embed AI, integrating intelligence into user and operational workflows

Deep prior AI experience is not required for this role. What matters is curiosity and a willingness to learn fast: We expect you to grow into AI leadership, and you'll have access to AI expertise across the Metro Global portfolio of companies to help.

What We're Looking For

6+ years of software engineering experience
3+ years in engineering leadership: direct reports not necessary, so long as you've worked to improve a team's development velocity through teamwork/process improvement
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders
Experience implementing engineering metrics and KPIs
A strong, hands-on technical background with modern web application architectures
Experience with Java backend development and a modern frontend framework
Solid understanding of CI/CD, DevOps practices, and cloud infrastructure
Comfort working in fast-paced, iterative environments
A willingness to learn and apply AI in a production setting

Experience at a similar-stage or high-growth company is a plus.

If you feel your resume alone does not sufficiently capture your ability to perform in the role, you may attach a cover letter to your resume.
